about: The Rival (RivalRules, docs/dev/unity-port.md section 9c): another summoner, simulated on the phone. Every day she pulls on that day's banner (banner_cycle), keeps her best prints, climbs alongside the player and can be challenged. Losing to her costs nothing; she only tags the Lobby poster until you win. The first win of a day pays her haul and one of her prints. Her heroes fight at the player's team level plus a daily wobble, as echoes at strength_bp. Tuned with tests/tools/rival_bench.gd (2026-10-19, 288 fights per value, players at levels 12-70 with stage-tier gear, with and without her counter-pick): at strength_bp 16000 the player wins 75% (56-100% by level); 15000 gives 87%, 16500 67%, 17000 60%, 18000 40%.
name: Rue
title: The other summoner

intro: So you're the other one summoning here. Cute. I'm Rue.
Someone's been pulling on my banners. Hi. I'm Rue.
idle: Watching your pulls. Not impressed yet.
My Spire run's going great. Yours?
Come fight me. I'll be gentle. Probably.
You stare at my poster a lot, {you}.
win: That's it? I barely warmed up.
lose: Fine. Take it. Don't get used to it.
Okay, that one stung. Rematch tomorrow.
Lucky. Keep the print, I have better.
Ugh. You're kind of hot when you win.
featured_first: {hero} came home with me. Sorry, not sorry.
misprint: My {hero} came out {flaw}. Worth a fortune.
{flaw} {hero} in my binder. Eat your heart out.
holo: A holo {hero}. Don't drool on it.
counter: Stacking {faction} against your {main}. I read you like a poster.
